service.name: Voice and video service
service.hint: The service module that carries the call for everyone in this world.

cameras.name: Cameras shown by
cameras.hint: The module that shows everyone's cameras in this world. Players may choose their own.

camerasPlayer.name: My cameras shown by
camerasPlayer.hint: Shows the cameras your own way on this account, or as the GM chose.

settingsWindow.name: Voice and video settings window
settingsWindow.hint: The module whose window opens for the voice and video settings.

status.reconnecting: Voice and video: connection lost, reconnecting…
status.waitingForGm: Voice and video: waiting for a GM to let you join.
status.gmNeedsSecret: Voice and video: enter the service's key in this browser's module settings, so players can join.
status.noMicrophone: Voice and video: your microphone can't be used. Check this site's microphone permission in the browser.
status.noCamera: Voice and video: your camera can't be used. Check this site's camera permission in the browser.
status.speakingWhileMuted: Voice and video: you're muted, so the others can't hear you.
status.cameraEffectFailed: Voice and video: your camera effect failed, so your camera stays off. Turn the effect off to show your camera.
status.microphoneEffectFailed: Voice and video: a microphone effect failed; your microphone goes on without it.
status.openMic: Voice and video: voice activity can't run, so your microphone is always on. Mute yourself or use push to talk.

ended.joinedElsewhere: Voice and video continued in another tab or window.
ended.kicked: You were removed from the voice and video call.
ended.roomClosed: The voice and video call was closed.
ended.auth: The voice and video service refused to let you in. Ask the GM to check the service settings.
ended.full: The voice and video call is full. Rejoin when someone leaves.
ended.unsupported: This browser can't join the voice and video call.
ended.noService: No voice and video service module is enabled in this world.

status.clientReplaced: Another module replaced Modular A/V's voice and video client. Enable only one voice and video module.

menu.name: Modules
menu.label: Plan your modules
menu.hint: See which Modular A/V modules exist, plan which ones this world runs, and get the links to install them.

check.name: Check GitHub for module updates
check.hint: When a GM opens the modules window, and at most once a day when a GM loads the world, the GM's browser asks GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com, which sees its address) for the list of Modular A/V modules, to tell of updates and new modules. Players never do. Off: the window shows the modules this version knows.

news.message: Modular A/V: {news}. See “Plan your modules” in its module settings.

noService.title: Modular A/V: no voice and video service
noService.lead: Nobody can join a call: no voice and video service module is enabled in this world. Each carries calls its own way:
noService.then: The modules window shows which are installed and gives the links for the rest.

modules.title: Modular A/V: plan your voice and video setup
modules.lead: Put the pieces you want on the board. Nothing changes until you follow the steps below it.
modules.failed: The modules window couldn't open. The browser console says why.

source.github: Checked GitHub for updates and new modules just now.
source.bundled: Showing the modules this version of Modular A/V knows.
source.offline: Couldn't reach GitHub: updates and new modules may be missing here.
source.off: Checking GitHub is off: showing the modules this version of Modular A/V knows.

updates.label: Updates available:
updates.hint: Update them on Setup (step 1), whenever you next go there.

status.runs: This world runs {names}. Add or swap pieces below.
status.runsNothing: This world runs no Modular A/V pieces yet. Add some below.
status.plan: Your plan: {changes}. Nothing has changed yet; the steps below make it so.
status.back: Welcome back. Installed: {got}. Still missing: {missing} (its link is in step 1).
status.backToWorld: Back to what this world runs.

service.label: Service
service.empty: Empty: nobody can join a call until a service is here.

cameras.label: Cameras
cameras.empty: Empty: Foundry's own camera dock shows the cameras.

effects.label: Effects
effects.empty: Empty: microphones and cameras go out as they are.

piece.swapped: {name} on the board; {dropped} back in the tray.

tray.label: Pieces you can add
tray.title: Pieces
tray.hint: Add a piece with its button, or drag it onto a socket. Drag a piece from the board back here to remove it.

helper.label: Help me choose a service
helper.question: Where should calls go?
helper.browsers: Just the players' browsers, no server
helper.browsersWhy: Peer to peer: free and nothing to run. Best up to 6 players.
helper.livekit: LiveKit Cloud, or my own LiveKit server
helper.livekitWhy: LiveKit: handles larger tables; LiveKit Cloud has a free tier.
helper.jitsiWhy: Jitsi Meet: uses the server you run, with token sign-in.

steps.title: Steps
steps.label: Steps
steps.serviceFirst: Add a service first: without one, nobody can join a call.

setup.title: 1. On Foundry's Setup screen
setup.who: Whoever runs your Foundry server does this. On a hosted server, use your host's install page with the same links.
setup.install: Install: Add-on Modules, Install Module, paste each link into Manifest URL, Install. Accept the modules Foundry offers with it.
setup.carryHint: The links can't follow you to Setup: copy them or save the file first. This plan stays saved in the world.
setup.chat: Send to my chat, for whoever runs your server
setup.chatDone: Whispered to you: copy it from there for your host. It isn't readable on Setup.
setup.leavePlayers: {count} players are connected. Leaving disconnects them until you launch the world again.
setup.leaveAlone: Leaving shuts the world down until you launch it again.
setup.leaveLinks: Have the links? Copied, saved or with your host.
setup.copyFailed: Copying isn't allowed here; select the text instead.

world.title: 2. In this world
world.who: You, as GM. Everyone's page reloads once.
world.done: This world already runs this plan.
world.keeps: {names} stays on until {name} is installed, so calls keep working.
world.reloadPlayers: {count} players are connected: their pages reload now, mid-call.
world.kept: The plan stays saved: it's here when you open this window again.

settings.title: 3. Check these settings
settings.livekit: LiveKit's settings: your LiveKit Cloud or server address and key (the key stays in your browser).
settings.jitsi: Jitsi Meet's settings: your server's address and app secret.
settings.theme: Voice & Video Settings, Appearance: make {name} the world's theme, or let players choose.
settings.effects: Tell players: {names} are in their Voice & Video Settings.

file.title: Modular A/V: modules to install
file.how: On Foundry's Setup screen: Add-on Modules, Install Module, paste a link into Manifest URL, Install. Accept the modules Foundry offers with it.
file.then: Then launch the world and open Modular A/V's modules window to switch them on.

modular-av-livekit.title: LiveKit
modular-av-livekit.what: Calls over LiveKit Cloud or your own LiveKit server. Most tables.

modular-av-p2p.title: Peer to peer
modular-av-p2p.what: No server: players' browsers link to each other. Best up to 6 players.

modular-av-jitsi.title: Jitsi Meet
modular-av-jitsi.what: Your own Jitsi Meet server, with token sign-in.

modular-av-dock.title: Dock
modular-av-dock.what: Cameras docked, floating, scattered over the screen or in their own window, with a voice panel.

modular-av-mic-denoise.title: Noise cancellation
modular-av-mic-denoise.what: Removes background noise from microphones. Each player turns it on for themselves.

modular-av-cam-background.title: Camera background
modular-av-cam-background.what: Blurs or replaces what's behind each player. Chrome and Edge.

modular-av-dock-vines.title: Vines theme
modular-av-dock-vines.what: Vine leaves around the cameras, glowing while someone speaks.

modular-av-livekit-krisp.title: Krisp noise filter, for LiveKit Cloud
